title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I'll stay with you until my next expedition, Doctor. Don't be afraid to send me out anywhere you need me.

title: Talk 1
original: I actually heard about you a long time ago, Doctor! Yeah, Mayer and MuMu told me all about you. I just had to come to Rhodes Island to see what you're like in person. Oh, I also got a little present for you! Here!

title: Talk 2
original: This one? It's an Emperor strap! Who...? The Emperor of Penguin Logistics! I visited that company a whole bunch, so I've met him lots of times. He's so cute! I give him plenty of pets every time I go! You ever pet him before, Doctor? You don't dare? Why?!

title: Talk 3
original: Is Iffy doing better these days? Last time I left Rhine Lab, she was in pretty bad shape. I've been worried about her…

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Has Mayer made anything new? I haven't worked on any new equipment for a long time, so I wanna do some research with her. Oh right, Doctor, I'll let you in on a little secret. If you bother Mayer while she's working... What? She already bit you?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Unlike Meeboo, Sisyphus or Kirkika, my drones are operated differently. There is a limit to how many I can run at once, and it's just the way it goes. But I have a new system in development. I think you'll be surprised before long.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The Polar North? The dreams that are buried there are cold and cruel, but... in order to make my dreams a reality, I am willing to do anything it takes.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: 'The tiny gardner, and the tiny flower, growing under the tile with no one to care for it...' It was Iffy's favorite storybook, maybe because it resonated with her. But, well... It seems like she doesn't remember it. Hmm… that's odd.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The North... it's both mysterious and beautiful. The towering cliffs, the lonely, snow-covered trees, the glowing, prismatic Originum crystals… And the vast snowland, stretching to the ends of the earth. Doctor, you should come see it with me. We'll go together, okay?

title: Idle
original: Doctor? Stay awake Doctor! If you fall asleep, you'll freeze to death!

title: Onboard
original: Rhine Lab Specialist Magallan just discovered a mysterous research vessel! And you are…? Oh my goodness, you're that doctor from Rhodes Island! Uh, W-Would you like to join my expedition!? Adventuring together would be really interesting!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Efficiency improved!

title: Promotion 1
original: Update complete! Now my devices respond twice as fast.

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, if you're curious about the results of my research, then I'll have to show you my stuff! Hehe, just so you know, I'll be showing you true power, so brace youself!

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the exploration and support to me.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Everyone, maintain communication, beep-beep!

title: Depart
original: Hold on, calibrating my equipment… Done!

title: Begin Operation
original: Preflight testing complete. Drones standing by.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Sure!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I bet you need my skills.

title: Deployment 1
original: Time to work!

title: Deployment 2
original: All my equipment's good to go!

title: In Battle 1
original: Is the target marked? Ok, launching drone!

title: In Battle 2
original: Now! Let 'em go snow blind!

title: In Battle 3
original: Three… two… one! Take flight!

title: In Battle 4
original: 'Bloom, my flowers!'

title: 4-star Result
original: Watch out, there's a blind spot in my scan—What, it's already over? All thanks to you, Doctor, you're reliable as ever.

title: 3-star Result
original: No more hostiles detected!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: There's still some enemies around. Are we going after them?

title: Operation Failure
original: They're flanking us? My bad, sorry…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Hm...? You even have heated floors?! Ahh, this is bliss.

title: Tap
original: Mhm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Come on, Doctor. Ice skating isn't so scary. I'm here with you.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor! My work's kept me too busy to take any time off to spend with my parents. But I sent them a letter, and a few samples I gathered in the North, heheh. Oh, Doctor, my parents know about you too. I told them about all the friends I made at work.

title: Greeting
original: Um? Anything I can help with?

title: Birthday
original: Phew! It took me a bit, but I finally made it in time! Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's a snowflake sample, it's from the furthest north anyone's ever been! I messed up a bit, but this one's the best sample I could get. It's my gift to you!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I lead an incredible life, Doctor. I've got the know-how to do my scientific research, I've got parents and friends who support me, and my dreams in the North to keep me going. But I still have one, tiny little wish. If somebody ever writes a history of the North, I want my name in it.
